consumers.usage: Its observability smoke test builds envelopes from this package, redacts them and sends them to the launched GlitchTip as JavaScript, Go and Python events, asserting that the release, environment, correlation id, incident code and component arrive; its Python helpers read schema/incident-codes.json and schema/redaction-rules.json rather than restating either. TEL-02 MOVED THE SMOKE'S IMPLEMENTATION to auto-pigeon-telemetry (scripts/smoke.sh and scripts/smoke/), which now consumes this package directly through an --aulibs path AUT hands it; what is left here is scripts/aup/observability-smoke.sh, the resolver that finds a launched stack's DSN, token, origin and releases and execs that implementation. AUT therefore still depends on this package indirectly (it passes the checkout and the releases) and no longer reads it directly. THE INC-01 DEFECT RECORDED HERE IS FIXED: verify.py indexed GlitchTip's stored events by `eventID` and matched that against each lane's `incident_id`, and INC-01 made `event_id` a fresh transport id per transmission, so every lane reported "no event with id ... arrived" although every event arrived. It now indexes by the searchable `incident_id` TAG that toSentryEvent puts on every event, and additionally asserts the `component` tag. AUP 127 FOLLOW-UP: AUT now also RESOLVES this package's directory and hands it to the AUP image as the named build context `incident-contract` — workspace_paths.py's incident_contract_dir (checked for package.json, src/index.mjs and schema/), written into .launch-aup.env as INCIDENT_CONTRACT_DIR and consumed by docker-compose.apps.yml, exactly as apmap-contract and game-params already were. It still does not READ the package. This exists because auto-pigeon/frontend/package.json depends on it by relative path, which OBS-02 added with no way for it to reach a Docker build: the AUP image did not build at all from ddf3bdf until AUP 127, npm ci linking nothing and tsc -b failing with six TS2307s, unnoticed because no ordinary test lane runs docker build. tests/test_incident_contract_context.sh is that lane. No package file was changed; this row is the only write. 241: scripts/aup/launch_incident.py (the launcher's one aut.launch_failed per failed launch) reads schema/incident-codes.json and schema/redaction-rules.json directly again, from the path lib/common.sh resolves as $aulibs_dir, and builds the toSentryEvent-shaped store event (fresh uuid4 event_id, incident_id tag, fingerprint [component, code, subsystem, operation], correlation_source=launcher). The 241 E2E harness (scripts/aup/telemetry_e2e/) builds bug-report documents through src/index.mjs buildBugReport/renderIssue and scans GlitchTip events and the bug-report sink for fixtures/bug-report-vectors.json's canaries.

OBS-04R. AUC's whole incident subsystem is built on it, and until that task AUC reported NOTHING - no dependency, no DSN key, no envelope, which glitchtip.sh recorded in prose while skipping it. src/incidents.ts uses createIncident, incidentCode, isCorrelationId, redactIncident and validateIncident; src/incident-transport.ts uses toSentryEvent to POST to the self-hosted GlitchTip's store endpoint, with no Sentry SDK, for the reasons AUP recorded in OBS-02. TWO THINGS ARE SPECIFIC TO AUC. (1) It holds a byte-for-byte VENDORED copy of the whole package at vendor/incident-contract/, wired as `file:vendor/incident-contract`, because its Dockerfile runs `npm ci` in two stages from a build context of that repository and a dependency resolving outside it fails there; test/incident-contract-drift.test.ts compares all 13 files against this package and fails on drift, skipping loudly with no sibling checkout - the same arrangement AUG has. (2) It redacts at RAISE time as well as in toSentryEvent, because a server's local ring buffer is read by whoever is diagnosing an instance rather than by the person the incident is about, and this process's strings can reach a token, an internal address or a filesystem path. The taxonomy was NOT extended, deliberately, for the reason AUG gives above: what distinguishes one AUC fault from another travels on `subsystem` (startup, room.create, room.dispose, room.handler, room.egress, journal, checkpoint, aub, admission, heartbeat, ownership, lease), which toSentryEvent promotes to a GlitchTip tag. Codes used as written here: auc.disconnected, auc.backpressure, auc.error, aub.unavailable, aub.timeout, aub.error. No package code was changed by AUC; this file is the only write. 241. Re-vendored 1.2.0 byte for byte at vendor/incident-contract/, now including fixtures/bug-report-vectors.json; test/incident-contract-drift.test.ts compares all 18 copied files. AUC additionally uses CORRELATION_HEADER and correlationIdFromHeaders (src/request-correlation.ts): every /internal/* route reads X-Auto-Pigeon-Correlation-Id (malformed = absent) and CheckpointClient, MapsClient and RegistrationClient send it to AUB whenever a valid id is in scope. bugReport/frames are vendored but not used by AUC. The stricter 1.2.0 value patterns changed no AUC expectation. No package code was changed by AUC.

TEL-02. The observability smoke test's implementation lives here: scripts/smoke/prepare.mjs imports createIncident, validateIncident, toSentryEvent and isCorrelationId from this package's src/index.mjs to build three synthetic incidents (AUP/render.3d, AUE/wad, AUT/observability) carrying one correlation id and deliberate fake secrets, redacts them through toSentryEvent, and fails BEFORE sending if a fake secret survived; the three send lanes transmit the resulting events with the real Sentry SDK for JavaScript, Go and Python, and scripts/smoke/verify.py reads them back out of GlitchTip and asserts the release, environment, correlation_id, incident_code and component tags plus the absence of every planted secret. THE CONTRACT IS NEVER COPIED HERE: the AULIBS checkout is passed in as --aulibs by whoever runs the smoke, and the script refuses rather than falling back when that path holds no ts/incident-contract. No package code was changed by TEL-02 other than this file.

241. AUCOM reported nothing before this. internal/incident/contract/ holds BYTE-FOR-BYTE embedded copies (go:embed) of schema/incident-codes.json and schema/redaction-rules.json; TestEmbeddedContractIsExactlyAULIBS compares both against this package, failing on drift and skipping loudly with no sibling checkout. internal/incident reads the taxonomy and the three kinds of redaction rule as data, translating JavaScript's Unicode `\s` for RE2, and TestRedactionMatchesTheJavaScriptReference runs src/redact.mjs redactText with node over a Unicode-whitespace corpus to prove parity. Because AUCOM has no third-party Go modules (enforced by its release tests), there is no Sentry SDK: it builds the store-endpoint event field for field as toSentryEvent does (incident_code/incident_id/component/subsystem/operation/correlation_id tags, fingerprint [component, code, subsystem, operation], fresh uuid4 event_id) and POSTs it, with the DSN key in X-Sentry-Auth. Codes raised, attributed to AUCOM: aucom.job_failed (job service OnFinished hook; kind/outcome only, never command, args, paths, profile id, account or token) and aucom.readiness_failed (bounded AUB /api/health check at serve start); reporting.telemetry_unavailable is recorded locally only. Correlation follows correlation.mjs (X-Auto-Pigeon-Correlation-Id, malformed treated as absent), minted ids tagged correlation_origin=minted. `companion dev fault job|readiness` (AUCOM_E2E_FAULTS=1 only) produces both through the real paths. No package code was changed by AUCOM; this row is the only write.
